review_candidates.title: Senior Sales Engineer, Indonesia
review_candidates.description: Get to Know Us Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results. What You’ll Do Horizon3 is committed to defending businesses from the ever-growing threat landscape. Our advanced solutions and expert team provide unparalleled security for our clients. We are looking for a passionate Sales Engineer/Solutions Architect to join our team and help prospects and clients understand the true value and capabilities of our product(s) and services. Technical expertise - Must demonstrate deep knowledge of our cybersecurity products and services, assisting the sales team in presenting and position them to prospects and clients. Customer engagement - Must meet with potential customers to understand their cybersecurity needs, challenges, and infrastructure, ensuring that our solutions are the perfect fit for them. Product demonstrations - Provide live demos and proof of concepts for our cybersecurity solutions, tailoring each demo to the specific needs and concerns of the potential customer. Solution development - Will work closely with the sales and product teams to design and refine our solutions based on customer needs. Technical training - train the sales team on the technical aspects of our products to enhance their ability to sell more effectively. Feedback loop - relay feedback from the field to our product and engineering teams, contributing to the ongoing improvement of our product. RFP/RFI assistance - Assist in answering technical sections of RFPs and RFIs. Post-sales support - On rare occasions, assist in post-sales processes to ensure the smooth implementation and satisfaction of our customers. What You’ll Bring Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, cybersecurity, or a related field. 5+ years of experience as a Pre-Sales Engineer/Solutions Architect, ideally in the cybersecurity domain. Strong understanding of cyber threats, risk management, and cybersecurity solutions. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Demonstrates ability to simplify complex technical topics for a non-technical audience. Highly collaborative with a strong sense of initiative. Language Skills: Fluency in the English language. Perks of Horizon3 Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive. Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities. Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking. Remote Work: We are a 100% remote company. Enjoy the convenience and work-life balance that comes with remote work. Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary and benefits which includes health, vision & dental care for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave. Compensation And Values At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations. You Belong Here Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law. Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless. Other Duties Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. Application Note In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

review_candidates.title: Lead Help Desk Specialist with Security Clearance
review_candidates.description: Grow, innovate, and generate progress: Harness your expertise to solve challenges and celebrate success! Job Summary The Lead Help Desk Specialist is a working lead position responsible for performing all duties and responsibilities of a Help Desk Specialist while assuming additional team leadership and administrative responsibilities. This role does not replace or reduce the incumbent's existing help desk support responsibilities. The Lead Help Desk Specialist is expected to continue providing phone and in-person customer support, troubleshooting technical issues, managing ticket workload, and meeting all Help Desk Specialist performance expectations while also providing day-to-day leadership, oversight, workforce accountability, reporting, and coordination for the help desk team. The position serves as the primary liaison between the help desk staff and program leadership, ensuring operational excellence, service quality, and team performance. The Lead Help Desk Specialist is first and foremost a Help Desk Specialist and is expected to perform all standard duties of that position. The lead designation adds supervisory, coordination, reporting, and team management responsibilities in addition to, not in place of, normal help desk duties. Key Responsibilities Team Leadership & Supervision * Provide day-to-day leadership, guidance, and direction to help desk personnel. * Monitor team productivity, workload, and availability to ensure operational expectations are met. * Deliver coaching, mentoring, and performance feedback to team members. * Foster accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the team. * Support onboarding, training, and professional development efforts. Help Desk Operations Oversight * Perform all standard Help Desk Specialist duties while serving as the team lead. * Oversee daily phone and in-person support operations. * Support the resolution of technical issues involving hardware, software, email, directories, and desktop applications. * Monitor ticket activity, workload distribution, priority issues, and escalations. * Ensure timely and effective customer support and issue resolution. Administrative Compliance & Accountability * Oversee timely and accurate timesheet submission and administrative requirements. * Track schedules, attendance, leave requests, and workforce accountability. * Prepare and submit a weekly activity report to the Program Manager detailing ticket activity, workload status, operational accomplishments, issues, risks, and personnel availability. * Address attendance, productivity, and compliance concerns promptly and professionally. Performance Management & Continuous Improvement * Monitor team performance against established service levels and operational metrics. * Identify process improvement opportunities and implement best practices. * Promote knowledge sharing and cross-training among team members. * Provide leadership visibility into team performance, challenges, and operational risks. Essential Duties * Perform all duties and responsibilities of a Help Desk Specialist. * Monitor and review team check-in reports to ensure visibility into ticket activity, workload distribution, accomplishments, and personnel availability. * Review timesheets and follow up on missing or late submissions. * Coordinate staffing and shift coverage to maintain uninterrupted support operations. * Escalate complex or high-priority technical and operational issues as appropriate. * Develop and provide weekly activity reports to the Program Manager summarizing ticket metrics, support activity, team accomplishments, operational concerns, and staff availability. * Support onboarding and integration of new team members. * Maintain service-level expectations and drive adherence to established procedures. * Promote communication, coordination, and collaboration among team members and stakeholders. Required Qualifications * Seven (7) or more years of Help Desk, Service Desk, or IT support experience. * Demonstrated leadership or supervisory experience within a technical support environment. * CompTIA Security+ certification, MCSA certification, or equivalent credential. * Strong knowledge of Windows operating systems, desktop applications, email systems, and directory services. * Excellent customer service, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Preferred Qualifications * Experience supporting DoD, DISA, DES, or other federal IT environments. * Active Secret Clearance; Top Secret Clearance preferred. * Experience managing help desk metrics and workforce accountability processes. * Experience leading technical teams in a customer support environment. * Ability to work onsite in Arlington, VA. What Success Looks Like * The Lead Help Desk Specialist is successful when: * The Lead continues to successfully perform all core Help Desk Specialist responsibilities while effectively managing additional leadership duties. * Team productivity, ticket queues, staffing coverage, and customer service performance are actively monitored and managed. * The Program Manager receives timely, accurate weekly activity reports providing visibility into ticket activity, operational performance, workforce availability, and emerging issues. * Administrative requirements, including timesheets and workforce accountability measures, are completed accurately and on time. * Service levels and customer satisfaction expectations are consistently achieved. * The help desk team is viewed as responsive, accountable, collaborative, and operationally effective. Physical Requirements This position is primarily sedentary and requires the ability to perform work at a computer workstation for extended periods. The employee is regularly required to sit, use hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard and mouse, and communicate effectively verbally and in writing. The role may also require: * Frequent use of a computer, including typing and viewing multiple monitors for extended durations (up to 6-8 hours per day). * Occasional standing, walking, and moving between work areas. * Occasional lifting, carrying, or moving of equipment weighing up to 25 pounds (e.g., laptops, monitors, or peripherals). * Visual ability to read screens, documents, and system outputs with or without corrective lenses. * Ability to bend, stoop, or reach as needed to set up or troubleshoot equipment. * Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.
